programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: You may not know that you've been eating Tonkatsu for years, Let Rachel reintroduce you to her version of the dish also known as, fried pork chops, served with an umami rich sauce.

programs.title: My Market Kitchen
programs.desc: Laura is in the stunning Adelaide Hills and cooks up an Italian delight, Ricotta and Silver beet Gnudi, while Matt makes a very tasty Welsh Rarebit.

programs.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programs.desc: It's pasta time again, so don't forget to salt the pasta water, and sauce your pasta the way the Italians do! Lidia prepares a pasta primavera, then a cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programs.title: Tom Kerridge's Pub Kitchen Secrets
programs.desc: Tom and his team craft a treacle tart with secret ingredients and sophisticated techniques to impress their guests.

programs.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programs.desc: There are few things in this world more comforting than a bowl of warm, hearty pasta. Silvia Colloca breaks down her favourite home-made pasta recipes, straight from Nonna's handbook.

programs.title: Food Safari
programs.desc: Food Safari enters the saffron-scented realm of Persian food - one of the most ancient cuisines on earth - to discover the secrets to cooking tender kebabs, how the rosewater iced dessert faloodeh is made, and why the Persian rice dish zereshk polow is so adored.  Maeve joins emporium owner Russoul Sajadi for a tour of the best rice, nuts, barberries and spices essential for Persian cuisine.
